messages:
Lina: Quick sync: we want a 2-post social mini-series for the launch — X single-image announcement + LinkedIn article-style post, plus a short 20s clip for both channels. Need copy A/B for headline, short video, 2 hero images. Can design pickup by Mon noon?
Javier: I can do hero images and the 20s clip (basic motion). Which aspect should the clip highlight? demo vs benchmark?
Ava: Benchmark-driven works best for PR; demo works for product folks. Propose clip = demo (show 3-second UI + caption overlay), static hero = benchmark stat + logo.
Tom: For copy testing: Variant A = metric-first ("2.1x throughput, 40% lower cost"); Variant B = customer-first ("How ACME cut inference bill by 40%"). We should test headline + CTA combos.
Lina: Good split. Also need tracking: use utm_campaign=launch_apr, utm_content=a|b. And route all webinar signups into HubSpot with source=organic_social and property 'social_series'. Ops: can you ensure Segment event -> HubSpot mapping includes content variant?
ops-bot: Reminder: Please include mapping key 'social_variant' in the registration payload.
Javier: Uploaded draft hero + clip: https://files.redwood/launch/heroA.png and https://files.redwood/launch/demo20s.mp4 — comments welcome.
Ava: Reviewed clip, suggest trimming 1s at the start and add a caption frame with CTA at the end. Also reduce music volume.
Tom: For X timing: post 9:30am PT on day 1 (announcement), follow-up thread 2h later with behind-the-scenes clip. LinkedIn article go live next day 10am PT. Thoughts?
Lina: Sounds good. Also want engagement follow-ups: 24h reply script for community managers + 48h outreach plan for leads that comment. Draft reply scripts please.
Ava: I'll write 3 short reply templates: praise, question, demo-invite.
ops-bot: Draft HubSpot workflow created. Test lead routed: tag=launch_apr, social_variant=A, source=organic_social. Notifying #sales-inbound via webhook.
Tom: For split measurement, dashboard requires CTR, reg conversion, demo requests by variant. Javier, can you label assets with variant suffix (heroA/heroB, clipA/clipB) so analytics matches?
Javier: Done — filenames added. Uploaded alt text and image copy as well.
Lina: Can product provide 1-2 short quotes for the LinkedIn article? Preferable customer-sounding blurbs.
Tom: Pinged product for quotes. ETA 6 hours.
Ava: Draft copy A (metric-first) posted: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy-A. Draft B (story-first) posted: https://docs.redwood/launch-copy-B. Both include UTM placeholders.
Lina: Small ask: in copy put the webinar reg link with utm_source=x for X posts and utm_source=linkedin for LinkedIn. Use shortener go.red/launchapr.
ops-bot: Scheduling checklist created: image alt text, shortlink, utm params, scheduled time, hubspot workflow id.
Tom: I'll queue posts in Buffer and set review for Lina. Anyone object to the times?
Javier: No objections.
Ava: All set, scheduled drafts saved. Will update after product quotes arrive.
Lina: Thanks team — will review drafts tonight and approve tomorrow morning. Remember to keep captions under 2200 chars for LinkedIn and <280 for X preview. :rocket:
